chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from some of his companions, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
When the guardian of the slain person dies, his child takes his place after him regarding the blood money.

key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: blood money, the financial compensation due in a killing case
key_terms.الْمَقْتُولِ: the person who has been killed
key_terms.وَلَدُهُ: his child, who succeeds him here
key_terms.وَلِيُّ: the legal guardian or entitled representative who holds authority in the matter

ai.seo_question: Who assumes the right to the diyah if the guardian of a murder victim dies?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the right connected to the blood money of a slain person. If the wali of the victim dies, his child succeeds to his position in that entitlement, indicating continuation of this right within the family line.
